items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Mike Costa playing alto too... Mike Costa was second... [INTERVIEWEE] Well he plays, he ended up playing saxophone though as he got older.

ctx.x: Most of the guys I played with, you'd always fake, we called them fake numbers, you know? They didn't use the word jazz too much maybe.

Yeah, I see Tom Brown and Luke Sciarro playing tenor there. Tom on bass. Yeah. He didn't lose trombone. Chicago trombone player. Cliff Curry playing alto. I guess he might be lead, I don't know. I don't think so. George Calder. Greg Terrio. Mike Costa playing alto too, it looks like. Well he was second trumpet player, Mike, at that time. Mike Costa was second, I got confused, yeah.
Well he plays, he ended up playing saxophone though as he got older.
